title: Actors Get LAZY Off Set? Here's Why 😴 #shorts
description:
Speaker reveals the struggle of acting being an "all or nothing" profession, where the only chance to practice your craft is *on set and getting paid*. He admits that without engaging "stuff to do outside of the acting world," he'd become "really lazy," highlighting the surprising truth about staying disciplined between jobs. ⚡
